primary.title: July 2026 DA hike: 3% increase most likely as June inflation data guides decision, says expert
primary.summary: 3% Dearness Allowance hike for Central government staff and pensioners is a possibility in July 2026. The final DA revision hinges on June AICPI-IW inflation data, with the government's announcement expected after Cabinet approval and inflation review.
